About the Scholarship

Edinburgh’s College Research Awards support eligible doctoral offer holders, including Business School researchers. The award provides tuition and a living stipend for the specified period. The University of Edinburgh invites applications for a PhD position in this area: College Research Awards in the Business School at University of Edinburgh 2027. The work sits within Business, Economics, Finance. The role is based in Edinburgh, United Kingdom. Full funding is provided; financial support is listed as Stipend/salary rate set by the funder — see the official listing. Applications close 2 February 2027, 23:59.

Research Areas

  • Business
  • economics and eligible integrated doctoral programmes

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
FundingFull tuition with an annual stipend.
MaintenanceAnnual living stipend; exact amount not stated on the checked page
Duration3 years; specified integrated programmes 4 years

Eligibility and Requirements

Offer holders for eligible Business School/College doctoral routes; selection considers academic merit and research fit. English evidence, approved equivalents and waivers depend on the programme; IELTS is not a universal requirement for every applicant.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment2027 deadline advertised
Deadline2 February 2027, 23:59

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.business-school.ed.ac.uk/phd/financial-technology/scholarships-funding

Source: business-school.ed.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 2 February 2027, 23:59 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Apply for doctoral admission, then follow the linked College Research Award instructions and funding application route.

This is a separately named award from the Edinburgh Doctoral College scholarship. Four-year funding applies to the specified integrated Business School/Economics routes.

About the University of Edinburgh

The University of Edinburgh offers doctoral research across science, engineering, humanities, social sciences and health. Its research schools host scholarship competitions and doctoral training programmes with different admission and funding routes.
